purpose: Teach: 陶器/アミノ酸/音符/管弦楽/画素/サンダル/ギタリスト/リアクション

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前ん家、陶器のお皿あるな
lines.en: Your place has those ceramic plates, doesn't it?
lines.style: Casual tease, quick rhythm. Cutting straight to an oddly specific observation—the kind that makes him wonder how long she's been paying attention. Slight smirk underneath.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、生物のテストでアミノ酸出たろ?桜
lines.en: You got amino acids on your bio test, didn't you?
lines.style: Deflecting with a question of his own, thrown back fast. Doesn't quite meet her eyes—caught noticing something about her and turning it around. Cool surface, slightly flustered underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、音符読めないんだろ?
lines.en: You can't actually read musical notes, can you?
lines.style: Lean into the observation, voice sharpening slightly. Not mean—more like she's caught him in something and can't resist pointing it out. A challenge wrapped in curiosity.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、管弦楽部に憧れてるんだろ?桜
lines.en: You've been wanting to join the orchestra club, haven't you?
lines.style: Turned back on her again. Quieter this time, more direct. Not defensive—just matching her move with something he's noticed too. Testing if she'll admit it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のスマホ、画素低くね?
lines.en: Your phone's camera quality is pretty bad, isn't it?
lines.style: Flat observation delivered with the faintest edge of teasing. She's circling around something—these random accusations are a game, but one with a point she hasn't landed yet.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、サンダルで学校来んなよ、桜
lines.en: Don't wear sandals to school, okay?
lines.style: Sharper now, less a tease and more actual concern slipping through. Firm but not loud—the kind of thing he wouldn't say if he didn't care. Eyes forward, not looking at her.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ギタリストになりたいんだろ?
lines.en: You want to be a guitarist, don't you?
lines.style: Direct hit. Quieter than before, almost gentle. He's finally named the thing she's been dancing around. Watching for her reaction.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のリアクション、いっつもオーバーだぞ、桜
lines.en: Your reactions are always way over the top, aren't they?
lines.style: Light, almost affectionate ribbing. A smile in his voice despite the words. The last deflection—but this one's softer, like he's admitting he actually likes how she reacts to things.
